audit.whatIsWrong: Both charts disagree with their own why-text and with the packet. Content said Skill at level 1 while whys[0] says Kled reels you in and chunks you; Skill at 4-5 while whys[3] says 'he keeps the bully window'; Skill at 6 while whys[4] calls it 'your one clean kill window'; Kled at first item while whys[5] says 'call it even'.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Kled/Skill/Kled/Kled/Gragas/Skill/Kled and the 43.1% win rate over 174 games confirms an unfavoured lane with one Gragas window at 6.
audit.corrected: Both charts flipped as one atomic group to Kled, Skill, Kled, Kled, Gragas, Skill, Kled.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spike windows carry no cooldowns, and 'a whiffed E is 13 seconds' is wrong for Body Slam at rank 1.
audit.why: Bear Trap on a Rope is 11s at rank 1 down to 7s; Jousting is 13s down to 9s; Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is 140/125/110 with a shield attached. Body Slam is 14s at rank 1. Those numbers are what make 'go in at 6' actionable — you have one Body Slam per two of his Joustings early.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into the cooldown block, trading rules and the level-6 spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page treats Bear Trap as a straight hook and never mentions the shackle window, never mentions that Jousting can be re-cast back through you, and never mentions that dismounted Kled's Q becomes Pocket Pistol — a ranged blast that knocks HIM backwards and restores courage.
audit.why: Riot's text: the trap only yanks if the target stays shackled for a short duration, so breaking range in that window cancels the pull entirely — that is the actual counterplay, not 'dodge it'. Jousting dashes out and can be cast a second time to dash back through the initial target, so Kled leaving is not Kled gone. And because Pocket Pistol both knocks Kled away and restores courage, wants.you[2]'s plan of Casking him off minions does not by itself stop the remount.
audit.corrected: Shackle-window counterplay, the Jousting re-dash, and Pocket Pistol's self-knockback plus courage written into the interactions block, the do's and wants.you[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: 'His engage hook. Dodge it.' was the whole cooldown section.
audit.why: Jousting at 13s is the more punishable cooldown than the trap, because it is his only way back out after he commits.
audit.corrected: Numbers and the Jousting window added.

edits.before: Kled owns these levels and you have to respect it. His Bear Trap on a Rope (Q) reels you in and his Skaarl autos chunk you before Happy Hour's heal has stacked up, so don't step up to throw a Barrel Roll he can punish. At level 1 you have one ability and your passive heal is negligible — concede the wave and last-hit safe. At level 2 take Q+W so a Drunken-Rage empowered auto plus Barrel Roll heals back his grab poke; that's your first even trade. Side-step his Q and his aggression falls apart, because without the reel-in he can't close the gap to all-in you.
edits.after: Kled owns these levels and you have to respect it. His Bear Trap on a Rope (Q) reels you in and his Skaarl autos chunk you before Happy Hour's heal has stacked up, so don't step up to throw a Barrel Roll he can punish. At level 1 you have one ability and your passive heal is negligible — concede the wave and last-hit safe. At level 2 take Q+W so a Drunken-Rage empowered auto plus Barrel Roll heals back his grab poke; that's your first even trade. The trap only yanks if you stay shackled: walk out of its 800 range in that window and the pull never lands, and without it he cannot close on you.

edits.before: Through 4-5 his Violent Tendencies attack speed out-DPS your sustain in a straight trade, so he keeps the bully window.
edits.after: Violent Tendencies gives four massively fast attacks every 10s and out-DPSes your sustain straight up, so he keeps the bully window.

notes: The trap's shackle window, Jousting's return dash, and dismounted Pocket Pistol restoring courage were all absent — the last one directly undercuts the existing wants.you[2] advice, which is corrected rather than deleted. Both level charts were out of step with their own why-text and are flipped as an atomic group to the packet. UNVERIFIED: report[8].t recommends Executioner's Calling because of 'his healing'. Kled has no heal in Riot's text — remounting restores a portion of Skaarl's health via courage, and whether Grievous Wounds affects that is not answerable from the kit file, so I left the item line untouched. Packet suspectNames flagged 'Happy Hour's' and 'Use Explosive Cask' — both false positives.
